title: Enable real Android/iOS artifact downloads and direct URLs on /downloads

requirements.summary: Ensure the Android APK and iOS IPA artifacts exist at the exact static asset paths so /downloads can show working download links.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` exists in the repo/build output and is served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` with an HTTP 200/OK response to a HEAD request.
`frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` exists in the repo/build output and is served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` with an HTTP 200/OK response to a HEAD request.
Visiting `/downloads` shows enabled download buttons for both artifacts (no 'not available yet' instructions).
Clicking the Android download button downloads a file named `SafeSpace.apk`.
Clicking the iOS download button downloads a file named `SafeSpace.ipa`.

file_operations.description: Add the built Android wrapper artifact at this exact static path so it is served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk`.
Add the built iOS wrapper artifact at this exact static path so it is served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa`.

Adjust the /downloads UI logic to treat both artifacts as available when the static files exist (as added in this change), ensuring the page shows enabled download buttons (and not the 'not available yet' instructions) for both artifacts.

requirements.summary: Show visible, copyable direct URLs for each available mobile artifact on the /downloads page.
acceptanceCriteria: When Android artifact is available, the page shows the direct URL string `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` in the UI.
When iOS artifact is available, the page shows the direct URL string `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` in the UI.
The displayed URLs can be selected and copied from the page (not only accessible via button click).

file_operations.description: When an artifact is available, render a visible, selectable/copyable direct URL text block for the artifact (using existing shadcn-ui Card/Button/Alert composition). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
